summary: Resolve UBU-Q0016 by accepting a minimum Compact Calendar planner grammar: skeletonization, legitimization, bounded candidate expansion, probability provenance with correlation safeguards, execution profiles, stored/reconstructed Plan policy, and MVP repair/coverage requirements.
rationale: The question is now answerable because UBU-Q0014 and UBU-Q0015 are solved. The proposal keeps Phase 1 implementable by requiring deterministic skeletonization, minimum legitimization, a greedy benchmark, bounded candidate generation, exact hard-constraint validation, compact default-Plan packaging, and local repair metadata, while explicitly deferring exhaustive optimization, GPU/cloud requirements, learned policies, and exact coverage proof.
commit_message:
Resolve Compact Calendar planner grammar

Add UBU-D0151 to define the MVP Compact Calendar grammar, execution profiles, probability metadata, stored/reconstructed Plan policy, and minimum implementation. Update DESIGN.md and mark UBU-Q0016 solved.
validation_notes: `git apply --check` was run against the proposed patch in `/home/sean/ubu-design` and passed.
Patch only modifies DESIGN.md, DECISIONS.md, and OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.
OPEN_QUESTIONS.md preserves the single-line metadata format and updates only the selected UBU-Q0016 block.
